pattern: に決まっている（にきまっている）
purpose: Express strong personal certainty about a conclusion.
keywords: Plain clause / N / な-adjective + に決まっている
After this much practice, of course you will improve.
I was certain the key was on the desk, but I was wrong.
Of course a meal you made yourself will make them happier.
formation: Plain clause / N / な-adjective + に決まっている
restrictions: Presents the speaker’s conviction, which may still be wrong.
mistake: Do not use this assertive expression as evidence by itself.
